explanation: I found no Mathlib declaration matching this theorem. It says that the ratio `xL q k / yL q k` belongs to `quotField q k C`. All three are the library's own definitions for Drinfeld curves (`CoordRing`, `xL`, `yL`, `quotField`), and Mathlib has nothing about these objects. The proof uses the library lemma `mem_quotField_of_gen` together with the library facts `gen_x`, `gen_y` and `sc_ne_zero`. The only Mathlib lemmas it touches are the generic `map_div₀` and `mul_div_mul_left`, which don't carry the theorem's content. I didn't search Mathlib, because the statement depends entirely on the library's own definitions.
